text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding things that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if the worst happens. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time, and new ones may appear. By following these steps, you can protect your goals and make better decisions, even when unexpected events occur.
